tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: The areas we pick up in, the current prices (in cents, before tax) and the subscriber discount, and the first day a pickup can be booked.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Whether we pick up at an address, and if we do, its pickup options: each day and how often (every week or every other week), the first pickup, when it comes back, and the prices with any subscriber discount.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Leave an email for an address we don't pick up at yet; we email them when we do.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The customer's profile, addresses (with their ids), Laundry preferences, whether a card is saved, subscriptions and one-time bookings, and upcoming pickups. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change the customer's name or phone number. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: add_address
tools.description: Save a pickup or dropoff address. The reply's serviceZoneId is null when we don't pick up there. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: update_address
tools.description: Change an address's label or Address notes, or its street (only until a pickup has been booked there). Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: set_laundry_preferences
tools.description: The detergent and scent every load is washed with, unless a subscription or pickup says otherwise. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: get_pickup_options
tools.description: The subscriptions the customer can start at one of their addresses: each option's serviceZoneScheduleId, day, how often, first pickup (nextDate), when it comes back (backDate), and prices with their discount. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: quote_one_time_pickup
tools.description: What a one-time pickup at one of their addresses would cost on a date, whether that date can be booked, and when it would come back. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: add_card
tools.description: A link where the customer adds their card on our site; booking needs one. You can't take card details yourself. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: start_subscription
tools.description: Regular pickups on an option from get_pickup_options. Get the customer's go-ahead on the day and price first. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: book_one_time_pickup
tools.description: One pickup on a date (check it with quote_one_time_pickup first). Get the customer's go-ahead on the price first. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: change_subscription
tools.description: Moves a subscription to another option, address or number of bags: it starts again, with its pickups booked right away, each at the price for its date. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Pause (until a date, or until resumed), resume or cancel a subscription, or change its bag count, Job notes, or detergent and scent. Canceling also cancels its upcoming pickups. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: update_pickup
tools.description: Change one upcoming pickup before we collect it: its bag count, Job notes, 24-hour turnaround, or detergent and scent. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: cancel_pickup
tools.description: Cancel one upcoming pickup (a subscription carries on). Before 8:00 AM on the day, nothing is charged. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: uncancel_pickup
tools.description: Bring back a pickup canceled by mistake, as it was (until 1:00 AM on its day). Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.

tools.name: list_past_pickups
tools.description: The customer's last 20 finished pickups, newest first. Needs the customer's Happy Hamper login.
